page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Left margin: year notes (Ann.M. column). Right margin: line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35. Running head top centre, page number top right. Catchword "quidam" at lower right.

main_text.p: 2373.Moses nascitur. ibidem. Historia natiuitatis est Exod. 2.

2413.Moses quadragenarius occidit Ægyptium.Ex-5od.2. Act.7.v.23. Vita ipsius diuiditur in tres quadragenas. Sub finem primæ quadragenæ occidit Ægyptium: sub finem secundæ eduxit populum. Exod.12: sub finem tertiæ est mortuus. Deut.34. 10verf.7.
main_text.head: Quartum interuallum ab exitu ex Ægypto ad templum Salomonis. 15
main_text.p: 2453.Israelitæ exeunt ex Ægypto. Hoc anno & præcedenti contigerunt gesta Exod.3.&seqq.ad 36. Post 40.dies lex promulgatur in monte Sinai.

2454.Tabernaculum incipit ædificari.Exod.36. Moses est dux populi per 40.annos in deserto, ab hoc 20anno 2454. vsq; ad an.M.2493, quo est mortuus. Hoc toto tempore contigerunt varia miracula diuina, multiplex rebellio populi aduersus Deū, & alia, quæ describuntur in Exodo, Leuitico, 25Numeris, & Deuteronomio.
2493.Iosua de tribu Ephraim, fit dux populi Dei, & ingressus in terram Canaan, primis sex annis debellat Cananæos.Iof.1.2.3.4.5.
2500.Terra Canaan diuiditur per sortem, &primus iubilæus incipit.Iof.14.&seqq. 30

2517.Othoniel, ex tribu Iuda, præest summæ rerum. Iudic.3. Hic quæritur,quomodo sint computandi anni, quibus Israelitæ seruierunt gentibus? Respondeo,eos,exceptis annis 18, esse numerandos partim in annis subsequentium, partim in annis 35præcedentium iudicum; non vero seorsim, vt

page.notes: Ann.M. is the printed heading of the left year column. Numbers 5 to 35 at the right are printed line numbers. A small mark appears near "Numeris" and is not a letter. The reference "ad 36." is printed with a space. The word "Ex-od." is hyphenated at the line end as printed.
